lines: Blockout round 1 has started on commit 48afed3. Machine checks are running: G1 to G4 are green so far. They take longer now that the real particle engine is behind every picture.
The macro camera's focus now sits on the cottage front, so the opening frame reads as a snowy night inside the scene.
Sound: three more takes were judged and none fits its line (lift, the winter shake, the winter landing). The winter landing is out of takes and plays silent for now. No new kept sounds.
Two replacement agents are at work: one moves the live simulation into a worker and speeds up the storm, one refits the live framing so the lifted globe stays inside the screen with a locked camera.
Next: the pack, then two critics from different families.
phase 2: 3.80 h used of its 6.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 4.99 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Frame 0 of the film from the macro camera after its fit and focus: the lit cottage, the lamppost and the foot of the tree in falling snow, no edge of the glass. Stand-in shapes.

The six cameras of the config on the winter stand-in stage at rest, review tier, each tile labelled with its numbers: hero, macro (new fit: distance 130, yaw -13, pitch 3, aim 67), interior, base, surface, low. Macro now shows the lit cottage, the lamppost and the foot of the tree with no edge of the glass. (by engine_builder)

The four seasons at rest with the real particle engine at its full pool through the stage's drawing, hero camera, preview, draft: winter, spring, summer, fall. Summer's seeds are now 0.5 to 1.1 mm so the scene shows through; it is still the busiest of the four. Miniature, base and lights are stand-ins. (by particles_builder)
